events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with potential implications for global oil prices and geopolitical stability. The conflict may lead to increased tensions between the US and other nations, potentially affecting trade relationships and economic growth. As the situation unfolds, investors should monitor the impact on oil prices, gold, and other safe-haven assets.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalating conflict in Iran may lead to increased oil prices, benefiting gold and other safe-haven assets. Conversely, the potential disruption to oil production may negatively impact oil-related stocks and ETFs.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil price movements and geopolitical developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit positions if oil prices stabilize or the conflict de-escalates

gains.extendedNote: If the situation spirals out of control
